responsibilities: pocketstation::recording::config::RecorderLineageField: Enumerates the supported recorder lineage field cases.
pocketstation::recording::config::RecorderLineageField::Session: Represents the session alternative defined by `RecorderLineageField`.
pocketstation::recording::config::RecorderLineageField::Source: Represents the source alternative defined by `RecorderLineageField`.
pocketstation::recording::config::RecorderLineageField::Stem: Represents the stem alternative defined by `RecorderLineageField`.
pocketstation::recording::config::RecorderLineageField::Clock: Represents the clock alternative defined by `RecorderLineageField`.
pocketstation::recording::config::RecorderLineageField::SourceGeneration: Represents the source generation alternative defined by `RecorderLineageField`.
pocketstation::recording::config::RecorderLineageField::PermissionEpoch: Represents the permission epoch alternative defined by `RecorderLineageField`.
pocketstation::recording::config::StemLabel: Stores the validated human-readable label used for one recording stem.
new: Creates a new `StemLabel`.
as_str: Returns the stable string representation of `StemLabel`.
pocketstation::recording::config::PermissionDecision: Enumerates the supported permission decision cases.
pocketstation::recording::config::PermissionDecision::Allowed: Represents the allowed alternative defined by `PermissionDecision`.
pocketstation::recording::config::PermissionDecision::Denied: Represents the denied alternative defined by `PermissionDecision`.
pocketstation::recording::config::PermissionScope: Selects the permission scope used by PocketStation.
pocketstation::recording::config::PermissionScope::SessionCaptureGrant: Selects session capture grant behavior for `PermissionScope`.
pocketstation::recording::config::RecorderStemConfig: Configures recorder stem behavior at its owning API boundary.
RecorderStemConfig::session_id: Identifies the session identifier recorded by `RecorderStemConfig`.
RecorderStemConfig::source_id: Identifies the source identifier recorded by `RecorderStemConfig`.
RecorderStemConfig::stem_id: Identifies the stem identifier recorded by `RecorderStemConfig`.
RecorderStemConfig::clock_id: Identifies the clock identifier recorded by `RecorderStemConfig`.
RecorderStemConfig::source_generation: Stores the source generation used by `RecorderStemConfig`.
RecorderStemConfig::permission_epoch: Stores the permission epoch used by `RecorderStemConfig`.
RecorderStemConfig::permission_scope: Stores the permission scope used by `RecorderStemConfig`.
RecorderStemConfig::permission: Stores the permission used by `RecorderStemConfig`.
RecorderStemConfig::label: Stores the label used by `RecorderStemConfig`.
RecorderStemConfig::sample_rate_hz: Stores the sample rate value for `RecorderStemConfig`, in hertz.
RecorderStemConfig::channels: Stores the channels used by `RecorderStemConfig`.
RecorderStemConfig::timeline_mapping: Stores the timeline mapping used by `RecorderStemConfig`.
